title: Hybrid UI illustration / Usage

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content area, default interactive state

slide_intent: Explain a product at the right level of detail so a conceptual introduction does not masquerade as an actual working interface.
strategic_value: Faithful UI elements combined with IBM illustration can make complex products approachable without losing their identity.
demonstration: Marketing examples, UI-to-illustration comparisons and layout guidance distinguish product introductions from detailed demonstrations.
practical_value: Choose hybrid illustration for high-level product explanation and prefer real screens when accurate interaction detail matters.

content_islands.name: Applications and role
content_islands.spec: Introduce website and print mockups, followed by the distinction between an overview and actual UI.

content_islands.name: Product-specific approaches
content_islands.spec: Compare non-Carbon, syntax-based and suite interfaces with their corresponding illustrations.

content_islands.name: Balance and leadspace
content_islands.spec: List product-fidelity tips and show how foreground assets sit beside text and buttons.

content_islands.name: Motion examples
content_islands.spec: Conclude with three product compositions associated with top-to-bottom leadspace motion.

reference_purposes.Intent: The page explains that hybrid illustrations clarify complicated product scenarios and inspire confidence.
reference_purposes.Expression: UI fragments combine with pictograms and conceptual imagery on pale brand fields.
reference_purposes.Application: Paired real interfaces and illustrations teach adaptation for non-Carbon products, code-oriented products and suites.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source specifies 60% UI and 40% illustration, rejects whole-screen substitution and reuse across different products, and distinguishes actual demos from conceptual overviews.

ingredient.name: Hybrid UI composition
ingredient.role: Introduce product functionality without claiming to be the product itself.
ingredient.application: Balance 60% UI with 40% illustration and stay faithful to the product. Prefer actual full product screens for detailed demos to avoid confusion; hybrid elements may appear in overview demos.
ingredient.scope: High-level product communications, not client stories. Hybrid UI illustrations must not be used inside the product itself; the source allows illustrations inspired by their composition style only without high-fidelity UI elements. For suites or difficult UI, it permits a more conceptual, lower-fidelity approach.

inspection.method: Six uniformly spaced sampled frames across the complete clip
